main_topics.reason: The user opened with widening part and thinning, and returned to its cause, progression and self-care across the conversation.
The opening question was whether the thinning is from PCOS or something else, and the user explored causes including stress.
The user asked what can be done and whether it is permanent, over several turns.
The user asked if spironolactone is safe and said they were nervous about hormone medicines.
The user asked what to bring and say so they are taken seriously, and planned to book that week.
The user asked in one exchange whether to see a regular doctor or a dermatologist.
The user said the widening part freaks them out and asked if it will keep getting worse, and mentioned being scared to look into it.
Blood tests for thyroid and iron were discussed as a way to sort out the cause, mainly bot-led and then used in appointment prep.
The user asked in one turn whether certain foods help.
The user mentioned a stressful exam period as a possible trigger, in one turn.
The user asked in one turn whether to stop straightening while waiting for the appointment.

output.summary: A user with PCOS asked whether their gradual hair thinning was from PCOS or something else. The bot explained possible causes (androgens, thyroid, iron, stress-related shedding), treatment options, spironolactone safety, who to see and how to prepare for the appointment. The user said it helped a lot, felt less scared, and planned to book an appointment that week.
